import items = "./items.qui"

class BomRow(string parent, string child, int qty_per, int scrap)

int need(BomRow row, int quantity)
    return (quantity * row.qty_per * (100 + row.scrap) + 99) / 100

class Bom(items.Item[] inventory)
    BomRow[] rows := []

    BomRow[] children(string id)
        string[] names := []
        for row := rows[]
            if row.parent == id
                names = names.append(row.child)
        BomRow[] result := []
        for name := names.sorted()[]
            for row := rows[]
                if row.parent == id and row.child == name
                    result = result.append(row)
                    break
        return result

    BomRow[] parents(string id)
        string[] names := []
        for row := rows[]
            if row.child == id
                names = names.append(row.parent)
        BomRow[] result := []
        for name := names.sorted()[]
            for row := rows[]
                if row.child == id and row.parent == name
                    result = result.append(row)
                    break
        return result

    bool manufactured(string id)
        return #children(id) > 0

    bool contains(string parent, string child)
        for row := rows[]
            if row.parent == parent and row.child == child
                return true
        return false

    string[] path(string current, string target, bool[] &visited)
        if current == target
            return [current]
        visited[items.index_of(inventory, current)] = true
        for row := children(current)[]
            if not visited[items.index_of(inventory, row.child)]
                rest := path(row.child, target, &visited)
                if #rest > 0
                    return [current].concat(rest)
        return []

    int low_level(string id, int[] &codes)
        index := items.index_of(inventory, id)
        if codes[index] >= 0
            return codes[index]
        result := 0
        for row := parents(id)[]
            candidate := low_level(row.parent, &codes) + 1
            if candidate > result
                result = candidate
        codes[index] = result
        return result

    int cumulative(string id, int[] &times)
        index := items.index_of(inventory, id)
        if times[index] >= 0
            return times[index]
        longest := 0
        for row := children(id)[]
            candidate := cumulative(row.child, &times)
            if candidate > longest
                longest = candidate
        times[index] = inventory[index].lead_time + longest
        return times[index]

    int[] planning_order(int[] codes)
        int[] result := []
        for id := items.ids(inventory)[]
            result = result.append(items.index_of(inventory, id))
        for: 1 <= offset < int(#result)
            current := result[offset]
            cursor := offset
            while cursor > 0 and codes[result[cursor - 1]] > codes[current]
                result[cursor] = result[cursor - 1]
                cursor -= 1
            result[cursor] = current
        return result

Bom read_bom(items.Item[] inventory, string[] &errors)
    graph := Bom(inventory)
    for entry := items.read_rows("bom.csv")[]
        fields := entry.fields
        parent := fields[0]
        child := fields[1]
        quantity := int(fields[2])
        scrap := int(fields[3])
        failure := ""
        if items.index_of(inventory, parent) < 0
            failure = "unknown item {parent}"
        elif items.index_of(inventory, child) < 0
            failure = "unknown item {child}"
        elif quantity < 1
            failure = "bad quantity {quantity}"
        elif scrap > 50
            failure = "bad scrap {scrap}"
        elif parent == child
            failure = "cycle {parent} -> {parent}"
        elif graph.contains(parent, child)
            failure = "duplicate {parent} -> {child}"
        else
            visited := array(#inventory, fill = false)
            path := graph.path(child, parent, &visited)
            if #path > 0
                failure = "cycle {parent} -> " + path.join(" -> ")
        if failure != ""
            errors = errors.append("bom.csv line {entry.line}: {failure}")
        else
            graph.rows = graph.rows.append(BomRow(parent, child, quantity, scrap))
    return graph

import items = "./items.qui"
import bom = "./bom.qui"

class WorkCenter(string id, int minutes, int efficiency, string description)
    available := minutes * efficiency / 100

class Operation(string item, int number, string center, int setup, int run)
    int minutes(int quantity)
        return setup + quantity * run

int center_index(WorkCenter[] centers, string id)
    for: index < #centers
        if centers[index].id == id
            return int(index)
    return -1

WorkCenter[] read_workcenters(string[] &errors)
    WorkCenter[] accepted := []
    for row := items.read_rows("workcenters.csv")[]
        fields := row.fields
        efficiency := int(fields[2])
        failure := ""
        if center_index(accepted, fields[0]) >= 0
            failure = "duplicate center {fields[0]}"
        elif efficiency < 50 or efficiency > 150
            failure = "bad efficiency {efficiency}"
        if failure != ""
            errors = errors.append("workcenters.csv line {row.line}: {failure}")
        else
            accepted = accepted.append(WorkCenter(fields[0], int(fields[1]), efficiency, fields[3]))
    string[] names := []
    for center := accepted[]
        names = names.append(center.id)
    WorkCenter[] result := []
    for id := names.sorted()[]
        result = result.append(accepted[center_index(accepted, id)])
    return result

Operation[] routing(Operation[] operations, string item)
    Operation[] result := []
    for operation := operations[]
        if operation.item == item
            result = result.append(operation)
    for: 1 <= offset < int(#result)
        current := result[offset]
        cursor := offset
        while cursor > 0 and result[cursor - 1].number > current.number
            result[cursor] = result[cursor - 1]
            cursor -= 1
        result[cursor] = current
    return result

Operation[] read_routings(items.Item[] inventory, WorkCenter[] centers, bom.Bom graph, string[] &errors)
    Operation[] result := []
    for row := items.read_rows("routings.csv")[]
        fields := row.fields
        id := fields[0]
        number := int(fields[1])
        center := fields[2]
        run := int(fields[4])
        failure := ""
        if items.index_of(inventory, id) < 0
            failure = "unknown item {id}"
        elif center_index(centers, center) < 0
            failure = "unknown center {center}"
        elif not graph.manufactured(id)
            failure = "purchased item {id}"
        elif run < 1
            failure = "bad run time {run}"
        else
            for operation := routing(result, id)[]
                if operation.number == number
                    failure = "duplicate {id} operation {number}"
                    break
        if failure != ""
            errors = errors.append("routings.csv line {row.line}: {failure}")
        else
            result = result.append(Operation(id, number, center, int(fields[3]), run))
    return result

int operation_week(int receipt, int lead_time, int index, int count)
    result := receipt - lead_time + index * lead_time / count
    return if result < 1 then 1 else result

int[] level_loads(int[] loads, int available)
    result := array(#loads, fill = 0)
    carry := 0
    week := int(#loads) - 1
    while week >= 2
        total := loads[week] + carry
        result[week] = if total < available then total else available
        carry = total - result[week]
        week -= 1
    result[1] = loads[1] + carry
    return result

import items = "./items.qui"
import bom = "./bom.qui"

class StandardCost(int material, int labor)
    total := material + labor

int component_cost(bom.BomRow row, int cost)
    return (row.qty_per * (100 + row.scrap) * cost + 50) / 100

StandardCost[] standard_costs(items.Item[] inventory, bom.Bom graph, int[] planning_order)
    result := array(#inventory, fill = StandardCost(0, 0))
    cursor := int(#planning_order) - 1
    while cursor >= 0
        index := planning_order[cursor]
        material := inventory[index].material
        labor := inventory[index].labor
        for row := graph.children(inventory[index].id)[]
            child := result[items.index_of(inventory, row.child)]
            material += component_cost(row, child.material)
            labor += component_cost(row, child.labor)
        result[index] = StandardCost(material, labor)
        cursor -= 1
    return result

string[] abc_classes(int[] values)
    int[] order := []
    total := 0
    for: index < #values
        order = order.append(int(index))
        total += values[index]
    for: 1 <= offset < int(#order)
        current := order[offset]
        cursor := offset
        while cursor > 0 and values[order[cursor - 1]] < values[current]
            order[cursor] = order[cursor - 1]
            cursor -= 1
        order[cursor] = current
    result := array(#values, fill = "C")
    before := 0
    for index := order[]
        if values[index] > 0
            if 100 * before < 80 * total
                result[index] = "A"
            elif 100 * before < 95 * total
                result[index] = "B"
        before += values[index]
    return result

class Item(string id, int lead_time, string rule, int first, int second, int safety_stock, int on_hand, int material, int labor, string description)
    string lot_label()
        if rule == "MIN"
            return "MIN {first}/{second}"
        return if rule == "LFL" then "LFL" else "{rule} {first}"

int index_of(Item[] inventory, string id)
    for: index < #inventory
        if inventory[index].id == id
            return int(index)
    return -1

string[] ids(Item[] inventory)
    string[] result := []
    for item := inventory[]
        result = result.append(item.id)
    return result.sorted()

class InputRow(int line, string[] fields)

InputRow[] read_rows(string name)
    text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/" + name))
    lines := text.split(NL)
    InputRow[] result := []
    for: 1 <= index < int(#lines) - 1
        result = result.append(InputRow(index + 1, lines[index].split(",")))
    return result

Item[] read_items(string[] &errors)
    Item[] accepted := []
    for row := read_rows("items.csv")[]
        fields := row.fields
        id := fields[0]
        rule := fields[2]
        parameter := fields[3]
        failure := ""
        int[] values := []
        if index_of(accepted, id) >= 0
            failure = "duplicate item {id}"
        elif rule != "LFL" and rule != "FOQ" and rule != "POQ" and rule != "MIN"
            failure = "unknown lot rule {rule}"
        else
            for part := parameter.split("/")[]
                values = values.append(int(part))
            valid := false
            if rule == "MIN"
                valid = #values == 2 and values[0] >= 1 and values[1] >= 1
            elif rule == "LFL"
                valid = #values == 1 and values[0] == 0
            else
                valid = #values == 1 and values[0] >= 1
            if not valid
                failure = "bad lot parameter {parameter} for {rule}"
        if failure != ""
            errors = errors.append("items.csv line {row.line}: {failure}")
        else
            accepted = accepted.append(Item(id, int(fields[1]), rule, values[0], if #values == 2 then values[1] else 0, int(fields[4]), int(fields[5]), int(fields[6]), int(fields[7]), fields[8]))
    Item[] result := []
    for id := ids(accepted)[]
        result = result.append(accepted[index_of(accepted, id)])
    return result

import items = "./items.qui"

int smallest_multiple(int quantity, int factor)
    return (quantity + factor - 1) / factor * factor

int lot_size(items.Item item, int week, int projected, int[] receipts, int[] gross, int horizon)
    net := item.safety_stock - projected
    if item.rule == "LFL"
        return net
    if item.rule == "FOQ"
        return smallest_multiple(net, item.first)
    if item.rule == "MIN"
        return smallest_multiple(if net > item.first then net else item.first, item.second)
    quantity := net
    finish := if week + item.first - 1 < horizon then week + item.first - 1 else horizon
    for: week + 1 <= later <= finish
        projected += receipts[later] - gross[later]
        needed := item.safety_stock - projected
        if needed > quantity
            quantity = needed
    return quantity

import bom = "./bom.qui"
import lot = "./lot_sizing.qui"
import capacity = "./capacity.qui"

import report = "./report.qui"

int sum_values(int[] values)
    result := 0
    for value := values[]
        result += value
    return result

class Params(int horizon, string[] peg_items, int tree_quantity)

Params read_params()
    string text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/params.txt"))
    lines := text.split(NL)
    horizon := lines[0].split(" ")
    pegging := lines[1].split(" ")
    quantity := lines[2].split(" ")
    return Params(int(horizon[1]), pegging[1:<#pegging], int(quantity[1]))

class ScheduleRow(int item, int week, int quantity, int line)

class Inquiry(string id, int item, int quantity, int week, int line)

ScheduleRow[] read_schedule(string name, items.Item[] inventory, int horizon, bool unique, string[] &errors)
    ScheduleRow[] result := []
    for row := items.read_rows(name)[]
        string id := row.fields[0]
        index := items.index_of(inventory, id)
        week := int(row.fields[1])
        quantity := int(row.fields[2])
        failure := ""
        if index < 0
            failure = "unknown item {id}"
        elif week < 1 or week > horizon
            failure = "week {week} outside horizon"
        elif quantity < 1
            failure = "bad quantity {quantity}"
        elif unique
            for previous := result[]
                if previous.item == index and previous.week == week
                    failure = "duplicate {id} week {week}"
                    break
        if failure != ""
            errors = errors.append("{name} line {row.line}: {failure}")
        else
            result = result.append(ScheduleRow(index, week, quantity, row.line))
    return result

Inquiry[] read_inquiries(items.Item[] inventory, int horizon, string[] &errors)
    Inquiry[] result := []
    for row := items.read_rows("orders.csv")[]
        string id := row.fields[0]
        string item := row.fields[1]
        index := items.index_of(inventory, item)
        quantity := int(row.fields[2])
        week := int(row.fields[3])
        failure := ""
        for previous := result[]
            if previous.id == id
                failure = "duplicate order {id}"
                break
        if failure == ""
            if index < 0
                failure = "unknown item {item}"
            elif week < 1 or week > horizon
                failure = "week {week} outside horizon"
            elif quantity < 1
                failure = "bad quantity {quantity}"
        if failure != ""
            errors = errors.append("orders.csv line {row.line}: {failure}")
        else
            result = result.append(Inquiry(id, index, quantity, week, row.line))
    return result

class Demand(int item, string kind, int week, int quantity, order_id := "", line := 0, parent := -1, parent_number := 0)
    string text(items.Item[] inventory)
        id := inventory[item].id
        if kind == "SAFETY"
            return "SAFETY {id}"
        if kind == "MPS"
            return "MPS {id} week {week}"
        if kind == "ORDER"
            return "ORDER {order_id} {id} week {week}"
        return "{inventory[parent].id} order {parent_number} week {week}"

class PlannedOrder(int item, int number, int receipt, int quantity, local int lead_time)
    original_release := receipt - lead_time
    int release := if original_release < 1 then 1 else original_release

class Allocation(Demand demand, int share)

class Supply(string kind, int week, int quantity, line := 0, number := 0)
    remaining := quantity
    Allocation[] allocations := []
    Demand[] roots := []

class ItemPlan(items.Item item, local int horizon, int[] receipts)
    Demand[] demands := []
    gross := array(nat(horizon + 1), fill = 0)
    on_hand := array(nat(horizon + 1), fill = 0)
    net := array(nat(horizon + 1), fill = 0)
    planned_receipts := array(nat(horizon + 1), fill = 0)
    planned_releases := array(nat(horizon + 1), fill = 0)
    PlannedOrder[] orders := []
    Supply[] supplies := []
    int[] order_supplies := []

    int past_due_quantity()
        result := 0
        for order := orders[]
            if order.original_release < 1
                result += order.quantity
        return result

class Plan(ItemPlan[] entries, int[][] loads, int[][] overloads)

class Promise(Inquiry inquiry)
    week := 0
    material_week := 0
    reason := ""

class PlanningData(Params params, items.Item[] inventory, bom.Bom graph, capacity.WorkCenter[] centers, capacity.Operation[] operations, ScheduleRow[] mps, ScheduleRow[] receipts, Inquiry[] inquiries)
    codes := array(#inventory, fill = -1)
    cumulative := array(#inventory, fill = -1)
    for: index < #inventory
        codes[index] = graph.low_level(inventory[index].id, &codes)
        cumulative[index] = graph.cumulative(inventory[index].id, &cumulative)
    int[] planning_order := graph.planning_order(codes)
    int[] weeks := []
    for: 1 <= week <= params.horizon
        weeks = weeks.append(week)
    int[][] scheduled := []
    for: index < #inventory
        row := array(nat(params.horizon + 1), fill = 0)
        for receipt := receipts[]
            if receipt.item == int(index)
                row[receipt.week] += receipt.quantity
        scheduled = scheduled.append(row)

    ScheduleRow[] receipts_for(int item)
        ScheduleRow[] result := []
        for receipt := receipts[]
            if receipt.item == item
                result = result.append(receipt)
        for: 1 <= offset < int(#result)
            current := result[offset]
            cursor := offset
            while cursor > 0 and (result[cursor - 1].week > current.week or (result[cursor - 1].week == current.week and result[cursor - 1].line > current.line))
                result[cursor] = result[cursor - 1]
                cursor -= 1
            result[cursor] = current
        return result

void plan_item(ItemPlan &plan, int horizon, int item_index)
    for demand := plan.demands[]
        plan.gross[demand.week] += demand.quantity
    projected := plan.item.on_hand
    plan.on_hand[0] = projected
    for: 1 <= week <= horizon
        int available := projected + plan.receipts[week] - plan.gross[week]
        projected = available
        if available < plan.item.safety_stock
            quantity := lot.lot_size(plan.item, week, available, plan.receipts, plan.gross, horizon)
            order := PlannedOrder(item_index, int(#plan.orders) + 1, week, quantity, plan.item.lead_time)
            plan.orders = plan.orders.append(order)
            plan.net[week] = plan.item.safety_stock - available
            plan.planned_receipts[week] = quantity
            plan.planned_releases[order.release] += quantity
            projected = available + quantity
        plan.on_hand[week] = projected

Plan run_mrp(PlanningData data, Demand[] order_demands)
    ItemPlan[] plans := []
    for: index < #data.inventory
        plans = plans.append(ItemPlan(data.inventory[index], data.params.horizon, data.scheduled[index]))
    for row := data.mps[]
        plans[row.item].demands = plans[row.item].demands.append(Demand(row.item, "MPS", row.week, row.quantity))
    for demand := order_demands[]
        plans[demand.item].demands = plans[demand.item].demands.append(demand)
    for index := data.planning_order[]
        plan_item(&plans[index], data.params.horizon, index)
        for order := plans[index].orders[]
            for row := data.graph.children(data.inventory[index].id)[]
                child := items.index_of(data.inventory, row.child)
                plans[child].demands = plans[child].demands.append(Demand(child, "DEPENDENT", order.release, bom.need(row, order.quantity), parent = index, parent_number = order.number))
    int[][] loads := []
    for center := data.centers[]
        loads = loads.append(array(nat(data.params.horizon + 1), fill = 0))
    for index := data.planning_order[]
        capacity.Operation[] routing := capacity.routing(data.operations, data.inventory[index].id)
        for order := plans[index].orders[]
            for: operation < #routing
                week := capacity.operation_week(order.receipt, data.inventory[index].lead_time, int(operation), int(#routing))
                loads[capacity.center_index(data.centers, routing[operation].center)][week] += routing[operation].minutes(order.quantity)
    int[][] overloads := []
    for: center < #data.centers
        int[] excess := []
        for load := loads[center][]
            excess = excess.append(if load > data.centers[center].available then load - data.centers[center].available else 0)
        overloads = overloads.append(excess)
    return Plan(plans, loads, overloads)

class PromiseResult(Promise[] promises, Plan final_plan)

PromiseResult promise_inquiries(PlanningData data, Plan base)
    current := base
    Demand[] promised := []
    Promise[] promises := []
    for inquiry := data.inquiries[]
        promise := Promise(inquiry)
        for: inquiry.week <= week <= data.params.horizon
            demand := Demand(inquiry.item, "ORDER", week, inquiry.quantity, inquiry.id, inquiry.line)
            trial := run_mrp(data, promised.append(demand))
            reason := ""
            for index := data.planning_order[]
                if trial.entries[index].past_due_quantity() > current.entries[index].past_due_quantity()
                    reason = data.inventory[index].id
                    break
            if reason == ""
                if promise.material_week == 0
                    promise.material_week = week
                for: center < #data.centers
                    for period := data.weeks[]
                        if trial.overloads[center][period] > current.overloads[center][period]
                            reason = "{data.centers[center].id} week {period}"
                            break
                    if reason != ""
                        break
            if reason == ""
                promise.week = week
                promised = promised.append(demand)
                current = trial
                break
            if week == inquiry.week
                promise.reason = reason
        promises = promises.append(promise)
    return PromiseResult(promises, current)

int demand_rank(string kind)
    return if kind == "MPS" then 0 elif kind == "ORDER" then 1 else 2

bool demand_before(Demand left, Demand right)
    if left.week != right.week
        return left.week < right.week
    first := demand_rank(left.kind)
    second := demand_rank(right.kind)
    if first != second
        return first < second
    if left.kind == "ORDER"
        return left.line < right.line
    if left.kind == "DEPENDENT"
        return if left.parent != right.parent then left.parent < right.parent else left.parent_number < right.parent_number
    return false

int supply_rank(string kind)
    return if kind == "STOCK" then 0 elif kind == "RECEIPT" then 1 else 2

bool supply_before(Supply left, Supply right)
    if left.week != right.week
        return left.week < right.week
    first := supply_rank(left.kind)
    second := supply_rank(right.kind)
    return if first != second then first < second else left.line < right.line

string padded(int value, int width)
    result := string(value)
    while int(#result) < width
        result = "0" + result
    return result

string root_key(Demand demand)
    rank := demand_rank(demand.kind)
    return padded(demand.item, 3) + string(rank) + padded(demand.week, 2) + demand.order_id

void add_root(Demand[] &roots, Demand candidate)
    for previous := roots[]
        if root_key(previous) == root_key(candidate)
            return
    roots = roots.append(candidate)

Demand[] sorted_roots(Demand[] roots)
    string[] keys := []
    for root := roots[]
        keys = keys.append(root_key(root))
    Demand[] result := []
    for key := keys.sorted()[]
        for root := roots[]
            if root_key(root) == key
                result = result.append(root)
                break
    return result

void peg_plan(PlanningData data, Plan &plan)
    for index := data.planning_order[]
        entry := plan.entries[index]
        Supply[] supplies := []
        if entry.item.on_hand > 0
            supplies = supplies.append(Supply("STOCK", 0, entry.item.on_hand))
        for receipt := data.receipts_for(index)[]
            supplies = supplies.append(Supply("RECEIPT", receipt.week, receipt.quantity, receipt.line))
        for order := entry.orders[]
            supplies = supplies.append(Supply("ORDER", order.receipt, order.quantity, number = order.number))
        for: 1 <= offset < int(#supplies)
            current := supplies[offset]
            cursor := offset
            while cursor > 0 and supply_before(current, supplies[cursor - 1])
                supplies[cursor] = supplies[cursor - 1]
                cursor -= 1
            supplies[cursor] = current
        demands := entry.demands
        for: 1 <= offset < int(#demands)
            current := demands[offset]
            cursor := offset
            while cursor > 0 and demand_before(current, demands[cursor - 1])
                demands[cursor] = demands[cursor - 1]
                cursor -= 1
            demands[cursor] = current
        if entry.item.safety_stock > 0
            demands = [Demand(index, "SAFETY", 0, entry.item.safety_stock)].concat(demands)
        supply_index := 0
        for demand := demands[]
            remaining := demand.quantity
            while remaining > 0
                while supplies[supply_index].remaining == 0
                    supply_index += 1
                share := if remaining < supplies[supply_index].remaining then remaining else supplies[supply_index].remaining
                supplies[supply_index].allocations = supplies[supply_index].allocations.append(Allocation(demand, share))
                supplies[supply_index].remaining -= share
                remaining -= share
        entry.order_supplies = []
        for: offset < #supplies
            if supplies[offset].kind != "ORDER"
                continue
            Demand[] roots := []
            for allocation := supplies[offset].allocations[]
                demand := allocation.demand
                if demand.kind == "DEPENDENT"
                    parent := plan.entries[demand.parent]
                    source := parent.supplies[parent.order_supplies[demand.parent_number - 1]]
                    for root := source.roots[]
                        add_root(&roots, root)
                else
                    add_root(&roots, demand)
            supplies[offset].roots = sorted_roots(roots)
            entry.order_supplies = entry.order_supplies.append(int(offset))
        entry.supplies = supplies
        plan.entries[index] = entry

string depth_label(int depth)
    return "." * nat(depth) + string(depth)

string[] where_used_lines(PlanningData data, string id, int depth, int extension)
    string[] result := []
    for row := data.graph.parents(id)[]
        int extended := extension * row.qty_per
        result = result.append("{depth_label(depth)} {row.parent} qty {row.qty_per} ext {extended}")
        result = result.concat(where_used_lines(data, row.parent, depth + 1, extended))
    return result

string[] allocation_lines(PlanningData data, Plan plan, Supply supply, int depth)
    string[] result := []
    for allocation := supply.allocations[]
        demand := allocation.demand
        result = result.append(" " * nat(2 * depth) + "ALLOC {allocation.share} " + demand.text(data.inventory))
        if supply.kind == "ORDER" and demand.kind == "DEPENDENT"
            parent := plan.entries[demand.parent]
            source := parent.supplies[parent.order_supplies[demand.parent_number - 1]]
            result = result.concat(allocation_lines(data, plan, source, depth + 1))
    return result

string[] grid_lines(PlanningData data, Plan plan)
    string[] result := []
    for index := data.planning_order[]
        entry := plan.entries[index]
        item := entry.item
        result = result.append("ITEM {item.id} LLC {data.codes[index]} LT {item.lead_time} LOT {item.lot_label()} SS {item.safety_stock} OH {item.on_hand} {item.description}")
        result = result.concat([report.table_row("WEEK", data.weeks, 6), report.table_row("GROSS", entry.gross[1:<#entry.gross], 6), report.table_row("RECEIPTS", entry.receipts[1:<#entry.receipts], 6), report.table_row("ON_HAND", entry.on_hand[1:<#entry.on_hand], 6), report.table_row("NET", entry.net[1:<#entry.net], 6), report.table_row("PLAN_RCPT", entry.planned_receipts[1:<#entry.planned_receipts], 6), report.table_row("PLAN_REL", entry.planned_releases[1:<#entry.planned_releases], 6)])
        result = result.append("TOTAL gross {sum_values(entry.gross)} receipts {sum_values(entry.receipts)} planned {sum_values(entry.planned_receipts)} orders {#entry.orders} ending {entry.on_hand[data.params.horizon]}")
    return result

string[] pegging_lines(PlanningData data, Plan plan)
    string[] result := []
    for id := data.params.peg_items[]
        index := items.index_of(data.inventory, id)
        entry := plan.entries[index]
        result = result.append("PEG {id} orders {#entry.orders}")
        result = result.concat(where_used_lines(data, id, 1, 1))
        for kind := ["STOCK", "RECEIPT", "ORDER"][]
            for supply := entry.supplies[]
                if supply.kind != kind
                    continue
                if kind == "STOCK"
                    result = result.append("STOCK quantity {supply.quantity}")
                elif kind == "RECEIPT"
                    result = result.append("RECEIPT line {supply.line} week {supply.week} quantity {supply.quantity}")
                else
                    order := entry.orders[supply.number - 1]
                    result = result.append("ORDER {order.number} receipt {order.receipt} release {order.release} quantity {order.quantity}")
                result = result.concat(allocation_lines(data, plan, supply, 1))
                if supply.remaining > 0
                    result = result.append("  EXCESS {supply.remaining}")
                for root := supply.roots[]
                    result = result.append("  ROOT " + root.text(data.inventory))
    return result

string[] explosion_lines(PlanningData data, string id, int gross, int extension, int depth, int[] &totals)
    string[] result := []
    for row := data.graph.children(id)[]
        index := items.index_of(data.inventory, row.child)
        child := data.inventory[index]
        int extended := extension * row.qty_per
        quantity := bom.need(row, gross)
        totals[index] += quantity
        result = result.append("{depth_label(depth)} {row.child} qty {row.qty_per} scrap {row.scrap} ext {extended} gross {quantity} lt {child.lead_time} cum {data.cumulative[index]} {child.description}")
        result = result.concat(explosion_lines(data, row.child, quantity, extended, depth + 1, &totals))
    return result

string[] bom_tree_lines(PlanningData data)
    string[] result := []
    for: index < #data.inventory
        item := data.inventory[index]
        if not data.graph.manufactured(item.id) or #data.graph.parents(item.id) > 0
            continue
        result = result.concat(["TREE {item.id} quantity {data.params.tree_quantity}", "0 {item.id} ext 1 gross {data.params.tree_quantity} lt {item.lead_time} cum {data.cumulative[index]} {item.description}"])
        totals := array(#data.inventory, fill = 0)
        result = result.concat(explosion_lines(data, item.id, data.params.tree_quantity, 1, 1, &totals))
        for: child < #data.inventory
            if totals[child] > 0
                result = result.append("SUM {data.inventory[child].id} {totals[child]}")
        current := item.id
        path := [current]
        while data.graph.manufactured(current)
            bom.BomRow[] rows := data.graph.children(current)
            chosen := rows[0].child
            for row := rows[]
                if data.cumulative[items.index_of(data.inventory, row.child)] > data.cumulative[items.index_of(data.inventory, chosen)]
                    chosen = row.child
            current = chosen
            path = path.append(current)
        result = result.append("CRITICAL {path.join(" -> ")} cum {data.cumulative[index]}")
    return result

string[] cost_lines(PlanningData data, Plan plan, costing.StandardCost[] costs)
    int[] usages := []
    int[] values := []
    for: index < #data.inventory
        usage := sum_values(plan.entries[index].gross)
        usages = usages.append(usage)
        values = values.append(usage * costs[index].total)
    classes := costing.abc_classes(values)
    result := ["item,material,labor,total,usage,value,class"]
    for: index < #data.inventory
        cost := costs[index]
        result = result.append("{data.inventory[index].id},{report.money(cost.material)},{report.money(cost.labor)},{report.money(cost.total)},{usages[index]},{report.money(values[index])},{classes[index]}")
    return result

string[] exception_lines(PlanningData data, Plan plan, string[] errors)
    string[] messages := []
    for index := data.planning_order[]
        entry := plan.entries[index]
        item := entry.item
        if item.on_hand < item.safety_stock
            messages = messages.append("BELOW_SAFETY {item.id} on hand {item.on_hand} safety {item.safety_stock}")
        for order := entry.orders[]
            if order.original_release < 1
                messages = messages.append("PAST_DUE {item.id} order {order.number} receipt {order.receipt} release {order.original_release} late {1 - order.original_release} quantity {order.quantity}")
            elif order.original_release == 1
                messages = messages.append("RELEASE {item.id} order {order.number} receipt {order.receipt} quantity {order.quantity}")
        balances := array(nat(data.params.horizon + 1), fill = 0)
        balance := item.on_hand
        for week := data.weeks[]
            balance -= entry.gross[week]
            balances[week] = balance
        covered := 0
        for receipt := data.receipts_for(index)[]
            needed := 0
            for week := data.weeks[]
                if balances[week] + covered < item.safety_stock
                    needed = week
                    break
            details := "{item.id} receipt line {receipt.line} week {receipt.week} quantity {receipt.quantity}"
            if needed == 0
                messages = messages.append("CANCEL " + details)
            elif needed < receipt.week
                messages = messages.append("EXPEDITE " + details + " to {needed}")
            elif needed > receipt.week
                messages = messages.append("DEFER " + details + " to {needed}")
            covered += receipt.quantity
        if data.graph.manufactured(item.id) and #capacity.routing(data.operations, item.id) == 0
            messages = messages.append("NO_ROUTING {item.id}")
        if sum_values(entry.gross) == 0 and item.on_hand > 0
            messages = messages.append("NO_DEMAND {item.id} on hand {item.on_hand}")
    for: center < #data.centers
        for week := data.weeks[]
            if plan.overloads[center][week] > 0
                messages = messages.append("OVERLOAD {data.centers[center].id} week {week} load {plan.loads[center][week]} available {data.centers[center].available}")
    string[] result := []
    for problem := errors[]
        result = result.append("ERROR " + problem)
    result = result.concat(messages)
    kinds := ["BELOW_SAFETY", "PAST_DUE", "RELEASE", "EXPEDITE", "DEFER", "CANCEL", "NO_ROUTING", "NO_DEMAND", "OVERLOAD"]
    labels := ["below_safety", "past_due", "release", "expedite", "defer", "cancel", "no_routing", "no_demand", "overload"]
    summary := "SUMMARY errors {#errors}"
    for: index < #kinds
        count := 0
        for message := messages[]
            if message.starts_with(kinds[index] + " ")
                count += 1
        summary += " {labels[index]} {count}"
    return result.append(summary)

string[] capacity_lines(PlanningData data, Plan plan)
    string[] result := []
    int[] totals := []
    for: index < #data.centers
        center := data.centers[index]
        loads := plan.loads[index]
        excess := plan.overloads[index]
        leveled := capacity.level_loads(loads, center.available)
        int[] utilization := []
        overloaded := 0
        peak := 0
        largest := 0
        for week := data.weeks[]
            utilization = utilization.append(report.percent(loads[week], center.available))
            if excess[week] > 0
                overloaded += 1
            if loads[week] > largest
                largest = loads[week]
                peak = week
        total_load := sum_values(loads)
        totals = totals.append(total_load)
        backlog := if leveled[1] > center.available then leveled[1] - center.available else 0
        result = result.concat(["CENTER {center.id} minutes {center.minutes} efficiency {center.efficiency} available {center.available} {center.description}", report.table_row("WEEK", data.weeks, 7), report.table_row("LOAD", loads[1:<#loads], 7), report.table_row("UTIL", utilization, 7), report.table_row("OVER", excess[1:<#excess], 7), report.table_row("LEVELED", leveled[1:<#leveled], 7), "TOTAL load {total_load} available {center.available * data.params.horizon} utilization {report.percent(total_load, center.available * data.params.horizon)} overloaded {overloaded} peak {peak} backlog {backlog}"])
    int[] order := []
    for: index < #data.centers
        order = order.append(int(index))
    for: 1 <= offset < int(#order)
        current := order[offset]
        cursor := offset
        while cursor > 0 and totals[current] * data.centers[order[cursor - 1]].available > totals[order[cursor - 1]] * data.centers[current].available
            order[cursor] = order[cursor - 1]
            cursor -= 1
        order[cursor] = current
    for: index < #order
        center := order[index]
        result = result.append("RANK {index + 1} {data.centers[center].id} load {totals[center]} utilization {report.percent(totals[center], data.centers[center].available * data.params.horizon)}")
    return result

string[] supply_lines(PlanningData data, Plan final_plan, string order_id)
    string[] result := []
    for index := data.planning_order[]
        entry := final_plan.entries[index]
        for supply_index := entry.order_supplies[]
            supply := entry.supplies[supply_index]
            serves := false
            for root := supply.roots[]
                if root.kind == "ORDER" and root.order_id == order_id
                    serves = true
                    break
            if serves
                order := entry.orders[supply.number - 1]
                result = result.append("  SUPPLY {entry.item.id} order {order.number} receipt {order.receipt} release {order.release} quantity {order.quantity}")
    return result

string[] promise_lines(PlanningData data, Promise[] promises, Plan base, Plan final_plan)
    string[] result := []
    on_time := 0
    late := 0
    rejected := 0
    for promise := promises[]
        inquiry := promise.inquiry
        header := "ORDER {inquiry.id} {data.inventory[inquiry.item].id} quantity {inquiry.quantity} requested {inquiry.week}"
        material := if promise.material_week == 0 then "none" else string(promise.material_week)
        if promise.week == 0
            result = result.append(header + " rejected material {material} reason {promise.reason}")
            rejected += 1
            continue
        if promise.week == inquiry.week
            result = result.append(header + " promised {promise.week}")
            on_time += 1
        else
            result = result.append(header + " promised {promise.week} late {promise.week - inquiry.week} material {material} reason {promise.reason}")
            late += 1
        result = result.concat(supply_lines(data, final_plan, inquiry.id))
    for index := data.planning_order[]
        before := base.entries[index]
        after := final_plan.entries[index]
        first := 0
        for week := data.weeks[]
            if before.planned_receipts[week] != after.planned_receipts[week]
                first = week
                break
        if first > 0
            result = result.append("CHANGE {data.inventory[index].id} from {first} planned {sum_values(before.planned_receipts)} -> {sum_values(after.planned_receipts)} orders {#before.orders} -> {#after.orders}")
    return result.append("SUMMARY orders {#promises} on_time {on_time} late {late} rejected {rejected}")

bool release_before(PlannedOrder left, PlannedOrder right)
    if left.original_release != right.original_release
        return left.original_release < right.original_release
    return if left.item != right.item then left.item < right.item else left.number < right.number

string[] release_lines(PlanningData data, Plan plan)
    PlannedOrder[] orders := []
    for index := data.planning_order[]
        for order := plan.entries[index].orders[]
            if order.release == 1
                orders = orders.append(order)
    for: 1 <= offset < int(#orders)
        current := orders[offset]
        cursor := offset
        while cursor > 0 and release_before(current, orders[cursor - 1])
            orders[cursor] = orders[cursor - 1]
            cursor -= 1
        orders[cursor] = current
    int[] available := []
    for: index < #data.inventory
        available = available.append(data.inventory[index].on_hand + data.scheduled[index][1])
    string[] result := []
    made := 0
    ready_count := 0
    bought := 0
    purchase_total := 0
    for order := orders[]
        item := data.inventory[order.item]
        header := "{item.id} order {order.number} receipt {order.receipt} quantity {order.quantity}"
        if order.original_release < 1
            header += " late {1 - order.original_release}"
        if not data.graph.manufactured(item.id)
            value := order.quantity * item.material
            result = result.append("BUY " + header + " value " + report.money(value))
            bought += 1
            purchase_total += value
            continue
        bom.BomRow[] children := data.graph.children(item.id)
        ready := true
        int[] requirements := []
        string[] details := []
        for row := children[]
            index := items.index_of(data.inventory, row.child)
            quantity := bom.need(row, order.quantity)
            requirements = requirements.append(quantity)
            if quantity > available[index]
                ready = false
            shortage := if quantity > available[index] then quantity - available[index] else 0
            details = details.append("  PICK {row.child} need {quantity} available {available[index]} short {shortage}")
        if ready
            for: offset < #children
                available[items.index_of(data.inventory, children[offset].child)] -= requirements[offset]
            ready_count += 1
        made += 1
        result = result.append("MAKE " + header + (if ready then " READY" else " SHORT")).concat(details)
        capacity.Operation[] operations := capacity.routing(data.operations, item.id)
        for: offset < #operations
            operation := operations[offset]
            week := capacity.operation_week(order.receipt, item.lead_time, int(offset), int(#operations))
            result = result.append("  OPERATION {operation.number} {operation.center} week {week} minutes {operation.minutes(order.quantity)}")
    return result.append("SUMMARY make {made} ready {ready_count} short {made - ready_count} buy {bought} value {report.money(purchase_total)}")

string[] value_lines(PlanningData data, Plan plan, costing.StandardCost[] costs)
    result := ["week,inventory,purchases,labor"]
    for week := data.weeks[]
        inventory_value := 0
        purchases := 0
        labor := 0
        for: index < #data.inventory
            entry := plan.entries[index]
            inventory_value += entry.on_hand[week] * costs[index].total
            if data.graph.manufactured(entry.item.id)
                labor += entry.planned_releases[week] * entry.item.labor
            else
                purchases += entry.planned_releases[week] * entry.item.material
        result = result.append("{week},{report.money(inventory_value)},{report.money(purchases)},{report.money(labor)}")
    return result

    params := read_params()

string money(int cents)
    fraction := string(cents % 100)
    if #fraction == 1
        fraction = "0" + fraction
    return "{cents / 100}.{fraction}"

int percent(int part, int whole)
    return (200 * part + whole) / (2 * whole)

string table_row(string label, int[] values, int width)
    result := label
    while #result < 10
        result += " "
    for value := values[]
        cell := string(value)
        while int(#cell) < width
            cell = " " + cell
        result += cell
    return result

void write_report(string name, string[] lines)
    if not file.is_directory("output")
        file.mkdir("output")
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL)
